speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me how long you've been experiencing these nosebleeds and petechiae, and have you noticed any unusual bruising or joint pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any bleeding from other sites, such as the gastrointestinal tract or urine, and has the child had any recent infections or fevers? Also, is there any family history of bleeding disorders?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Frequent epistaxis. I also have Mucous membrane bleeding, Diffuse petechiae on distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a family history of bleeding disorders, and has the child experienced any recent viral infections? I will also check for any hepatosplenomegaly or lymphadenopathy during the physical exam.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical issues. Up-to-date on vaccinations. Social history: Attends preschool. Lives with parents and one older sibling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the older sibling or any other family member have a history of easy bruising or bleeding disorders? I need to order a Complete Blood Count and a coagulation panel to check for platelet counts and clotting factors. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the results; the normal platelet count rules out thrombocytopenia, so I need to evaluate for a qualitative platelet defect or coagulation factor deficiency. REQUEST TEST: Coagulation_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the coagulation studies are normal, I suspect a qualitative platelet defect like Glanzmann thrombasthenia or Bernard-Soulier syndrome. REQUEST TEST: Platelet_Function_Assay
